review_corrections.change: Pooled '6000 draws' statements withdrawn; draws of different nulls are never pooled. per_null_ranks gives, for every null separately, draws_ge_observed, rank, max, q95 and q99 for spin6, magnetic16 and joint32 (all48 and the selection-matched exclusion, jk1 and jk2). null_structure states that the three permutation nulls relabel one Quaia realization and the two complement nulls relabel fixed complement samples (subset relation computed). (b+1)/(N+1) is reported only for the within-stratum permutation nulls, as an exact conditional permutation p-value; complement nulls get the rank only. Spin is flagged as selected after R104.

Each null draw applies the R104 influence rule (top delete-one shift-norm patch in curvature row 0, top distinct patch in row 1) to its own all-48 delete-one refits in three sector variants (E2+B2 primary, B2, E2). The excluded-configuration null tables and exclusion ratios use that per-draw selection; the rule spread is reported; the fixed-(8,47) tables survive only under fixed_patch_conditional_diagnostic.

Docstring describes 8/47 as the top row-0 (every sector) and row-1 E2/B2 patches. observed.json replays the R104 per-row/sector delete-one top-5 and worst delete-two pair from the R98 cache (checked against GAIA_PATCH_INFLUENCE.json) and reports observed statistics after the alternative exclusions {32}, {43,47}, {8,47,32}, {8,47,43}, {8,47,32,43} with the largest relative spin6 change.

Docstring restricted to frames evaluated at the shell medians. observed.json adds a direct per-source z-linear frame injection (R105 test frame), its curvature leak, the precision-weighted effective shell redshifts, the leak's own spin6 quadratic form, and the spin slope that a leak-only explanation would need.

Docstring no longer says patch_gmag_colour keeps the magnitude composition. observed.json reports the exact within-stratum-permutation expectation of the shell G and BP-RP curvature and the retained fraction for each permutation null, plus a patch x G8 x C4 stratification that is evaluated but not run as a null.
idealized_hotelling_reference carries a scope string and the empirical/Hotelling q95 ratio for every null, configuration and statistic.

FULL_JOIN sha256 pinned, fail closed if missing or changed, and recorded; the CRF3 FITS sha is verified for every null kind (it sets the BP-RP strata); the R105 parity JSON is checked against a pinned sha; every output JSON records the sha256 of this script and of every imported scripts.* module, git HEAD, the git status of those files, and the command.
